}

    on_actions = { oe_v61_roman_after_lobby }
}

}

    on_actions = { oe_v61_roman_yearly_pulse }

oe_v61_roman_on_start = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 361 }
    effect = {
        oe_v61_roman_bootstrap_pillars_pre1337 = yes
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } }
            c:BYZ = { oe_v61_roman_sync_stage_effect = yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } }
            c:ROM = { oe_v61_roman_sync_stage_effect = yes }
        }
    }
}

oe_v61_roman_after_lobby = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 361 }
    effect = {
        oe_v61_roman_bootstrap_pillars_pre1337 = yes
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } }
            c:BYZ = { oe_v61_roman_sync_stage_effect = yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } }
            c:ROM = { oe_v61_roman_sync_stage_effect = yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { current_year >= 361 current_year <= 535 }
            every_country = {
                limit = { oe_is_western_phoenix_empire = yes }
                oe_v61_roman_sync_stage_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_v61_roman_on_formed = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 361
